rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption sits directly left of or above it, or the printed item number on its row. Schedule amounts in single text cells (Schedules 1-5, 10 and the Schedule 6 total) take plain text joins and print as the writer holds them. Items 1, 3, 4, 13 and 21 options and the Instructions A/B boxes take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option). Part II and the 12-slot Schedule 7, 8 and 9 amounts (Schedule 9 continuation columns excepted) have no centavo comb, so no money_joins pair exists and each one takes a peso_joins entry that prints the amount rounded to whole pesos. Schedule 6 rows 1-4 and Schedule 7.1/8.1 rows 4-7 print no row number: they take the printed row order under their column headers (the layout numbers them in the same order). Item 5 takes the MCIT box, the other-code box and code cell by the model's meaning. Schedule 1 effectivity dates have no layout keys and stay blank. Stamped TIN combs (name=) take no join. Since #113: Item 2, Item 10, the Part III dates and the page 2-4 TIN combs print (derived: keys of Form1702MXDraft::to_print_field_map, date_joins); every other value has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
